ordered_diagnoses: Primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the central nervous system

s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive neurological decline with motor and speech impairment
salient_findings: Episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
key_facts: Woman in her mid-60s
Initial carpal tunnel release surgery
Tremors recurred 7 months later
Referred to a neurologist
Developed progressive right-sided weakness over 3 months
Brain MRI showed hyperintensities in bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter and other areas
No contrast enhancement on T1-weighted FLAIR MRI
Brain biopsy showed CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ cells
Cerebrospinal fluid contained lymphoma cells
Bone marrow was negative for lymphoma cells

shortlist: Primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the central nervous system

shortlist.label: Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Brain biopsy showed CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ cells and cerebrospinal fluid contained lymphoma cells

shortlist.label: Primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the central nervous system
shortlist.why_kept: Brain biopsy and cerebrospinal fluid findings are consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Intravascular Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive neurological decline and presence of lymphoma cells in cerebrospinal fluid

shortlist.label: Neurolymphomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Involvement of central nervous system and presence of lymphoma cells in cerebrospinal fluid

shortlist.label: Cerebral lymphomatoid granulomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Brain MRI showed hyperintensities in bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter and presence of lymphoma cells in cerebrospinal fluid

raw.rationale: The presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and the brain biopsy showing CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ cells, along with the extensive non-enhancing lesions in the bilateral cerebral hemispheres on MRI, are consistent with Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma.

rejected.label: Primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the central nervous system
rejected.why: While this is a subtype of PCNSL, the provided information does not specifically indicate diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

rejected.label: Intravascular Lymphoma
rejected.why: This condition typically presents with lymphoma cells within blood vessels, which is not indicated by the biopsy or imaging findings.

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: This condition involves lymphoma infiltration of the peripheral nervous system, which is not the primary presentation in this case.

rejected.label: Cerebral lymphomatoid granulomatosis
rejected.why: This is a rare condition with a distinct histological appearance, which is not described in the biopsy results.
